card.name: Small words inside drug interaction instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "be", "the" and "to", and verbs like "decrease", in drug-interaction or precaution sentences. Often after "should" or "decrease", just before a verb or a dose term.

modes.description: The word "be" right after "should" in an instruction about a drug.
